screening_decisions.reason: Factorial RCT primarily compares two decision aids and randomizes surgeons to receive a patient preference report versus usual care. This is not PROMs feedback on patient-reported health outcomes; it reports preferences/goals, and the main outcomes are knowledge, surgery rates, and satisfaction. Does not match PROM feedback versus no feedback on PROs.

RCT in general dental practice where dentists were informed of patients’ MDAS (a PROM) versus not informed; outcome was change in patient-reported state anxiety (STAI-S). Direct PROM feedback to provider versus no feedback with patient-reported outcomes measured.

Randomized controlled trial of session-by-session progress feedback using a brief PROM (Outcome Rating Scale) to therapists versus no feedback; outcomes are therapeutic outcomes reported by clients. Aligns with PROM feedback to clinicians versus no feedback.

Both arms received PROM feedback to therapists; the difference was whether feedback was also discussed in supervision (therapist+supervisor alerts) versus therapist-only. Not a comparison of PROM feedback versus no feedback.

Randomized controlled trial where patients in the intervention self-monitor HRQoL and symptoms and receive tailored PROM-based feedback and options versus delayed access. This is PROM feedback provided to patients; compares feedback versus no access.
Integrated literature review; not a randomized trial and does not compare PROM feedback versus no feedback.

Mobile telehealth intervention includes self-monitoring data transmission, graphical and nurse-initiated feedback based on physiological measures; not PROM feedback. Patient-reported outcomes were measured for research but not fed back as PROMs to providers/patients.

Prospective RCT with three arms: routine HRQL/HADS completion with feedback to physicians versus completion without feedback versus no measurement. Directly evaluates PROM feedback to clinicians and its effects on communication and patient HRQL.

Randomized design where physicians were informed versus not informed of patients’ positive depression screen (Zung). Tests effect of PROM feedback to providers on recognition/treatment and short-term outcomes.
Laboratory study on performance feedback and perceived impairment; not a clinical RCT of PROM feedback to providers/patients on health outcomes in clinical practice.

Physicians randomized to receive feedback summarizing patients’ anxiety symptoms and functioning (PROMs) versus control; patient outcomes followed over five months. Direct PROM feedback to providers versus no feedback.
Validation/acceptability study of SF-36 using postal questionnaires; not a randomized trial of PROM feedback versus no feedback and no clinical feedback component.

RCT of an internet-based intervention including automated monitoring and feedback to users versus waiting list; compares PROM-based feedback to patients versus no intervention. Although outside a traditional clinic, it meets the criterion of PROM feedback to patients.

RCT where both groups completed PROMs, but only intervention physicians received summary reports (feedback) versus no feedback. Outcomes assessed after one year. Directly matches PROM feedback to providers versus no feedback.

Educational and training interventions (home monitoring, peak flow training with/without feedback, discrimination training) focus on physiologic monitoring and perception tasks; not PROM feedback to providers/patients in routine clinical practice.
Feasibility RCT of a supportive care package; the abstract does not indicate PROM feedback to providers or patients versus no feedback. Insufficient evidence of PROM feedback as the intervention.
Structured review; not a randomized trial and does not directly compare PROM feedback versus no feedback.
Not a randomized trial of PROMs feedback; observational analysis of VTE risk unrelated to PROMs feedback interventions.

Randomized comparison of providing systematic pain PROMs (and depression scale) feedback to clinicians/patients versus usual assessment, evaluating medication changes and patient pain—matches PROMs feedback RCT.
Feasibility/psychometric study; no randomized comparison of PROMs feedback versus no feedback on outcomes/processes of care.
RCT using a self-reported Work Stress Questionnaire with physician feedback versus usual care, assessing processes of care—fits PROMs feedback to clinicians.
RCT of monthly monitoring using PROMs (HADS, EORTC) triggering referral versus educational materials alone; evaluates patient-reported distress—meets PROMs feedback criteria.
Randomized feedback versus no feedback using a PROM (OQ-45.2) in psychotherapy; assesses outcomes—direct PROMs feedback trial.
Pilot RCT with app-based weekly symptom PROM reporting (ESAS) providing patient-directed recommendations versus control; assesses QoL/engagement—aligns with PROMs feedback to patients.
Cross-sectional format-interpretation study; not a randomized clinical trial of PROMs feedback impacting outcomes/processes of care.
Education/knowledge-test feedback intervention; not PROMs feedback to clinicians/patients designed to change care based on PROMs.
Qualitative interview study of GP opinions; not a randomized trial and not testing PROMs feedback effects.
Self-management training integrated into rehab; not a PROMs feedback versus no feedback trial.
RCT manipulating feedback of patient-completed psychiatric screening (patient/physician informed vs not); evaluates referral processes—meets PROMs feedback to patients/clinicians.

Cluster RCT design providing physicians real-time patient-reported symptom/side-effect data via IVR versus educational calls; targets QoL and treatment titration—fits PROMs feedback framework (include at screening).
RCT comparing routine HRQL PROM assessment (with/without interpretive assistance) versus usual care; assesses HRQL/satisfaction—core PROMs feedback trial.
RCT making patient-reported needs/QoL data available to the care team with targeted interventions versus not available; evaluates QOL/psychosocial outcomes—PROMs feedback to clinicians.
Protocol for RCT of self-monitoring with personalized feedback to patients versus no add-on; aligns with PROMs feedback concept—include at screening stage despite being a protocol.
Internet-based self-help with automated user feedback versus waitlist; not routine clinical PROMs feedback to healthcare providers.
Scoping review; not a randomized trial of PROMs feedback.
Randomized trial feeding back patient-reported needs/symptoms to a caseworker or clinicians versus usual care; assesses PROs and care processes.
Methodological paper on meta-analysis inconsistency; not a PROMs feedback trial.
Randomized assessment of QoL questionnaire with feedback during clinic vs attention control/no questionnaire; evaluates issues identified and actions.
Randomized variation of screening, physician sensitization, and informational feedback from a depression scale to clinicians; examines documentation and management.
Exploratory qualitative/semistructured interviews; not a randomized feedback intervention.
General feedback meta-analysis/theory; not a clinical PROMs feedback randomized trial.
Cluster-randomized health status (AIMS/MHAQ) reports fed back to clinicians vs attention placebo and control; assesses processes and health status.
Randomized trial providing pain scale summaries to oncologists vs usual care; evaluates analgesic management and pain outcomes.
Tool development (EMPRO) study; not a clinical feedback RCT.
Cluster-randomized counseling by pharmacists; no PROMs feedback component.
Narrative/theory review of PRO applications; not a randomized feedback study.
Pilot randomized trial of daily electronic symptom reporting to nurses during inpatient HCT; reduced peak symptom burden.
Randomized trial of at-home symptom monitoring with automated clinician alerts vs no alerts; reduced postoperative symptom severity.
Randomized feedback of GHQ screening results to primary care clinicians; examines detection/management processes.
Randomized comparison of two active strategies (nurse-led comorbidity program vs patient self-assessment) without a no-feedback control for PROMs feedback.
Randomized controlled trial of OQ-45 feedback in psychiatric outpatients vs control; evaluates outcomes.
Phase III randomized trial of web-mediated follow-up with weekly self-reported symptoms triggering oncologist alerts vs routine surveillance; improved OS and processes.
Instrument development (NFI-MND); not a feedback RCT.
Pilot RCT of personality test feedback to patients for engagement; not PROMs feedback about health outcomes/processes to clinicians in routine care.
Commentary/review; not a randomized trial.
Randomized crossover trial with standardized HRQL summaries provided to physicians/patients vs control; improves discussion/awareness.
Randomized clinical trial providing PROMIS SPADE symptom scores to primary care clinicians vs not; symptom outcomes and documentation assessed.
Randomized trial in schizophrenia comparing standard care, QoL assessment only, and QoL assessment with feedback to clinicians; patient satisfaction and outcomes measured.
Multicenter randomized trial feeding back pediatric PROs to providers/families vs no feedback; assesses HRQoL and symptom distress.
Randomized trial comparing evidence-based parent-reported screening tools provided pre-visit vs usual care; detection rates (process of care) assessed.
Randomized trial of a tailored QoL diagnosis/therapy pathway with QoL profile/expert report to practitioner vs standard care; PROMs-driven feedback and actions.
Advisory board commentary on a cluster RCT; not the primary randomized trial report.
Randomized trial of electronic Lung Cancer Symptom Scale with real-time data to oncologists vs standard assessment; referrals/supportive care and HRQoL outcomes.
Prospective controlled before–after design without randomization; does not meet the randomized trial criterion.
Prospective study with randomized disclosure of depression questionnaire results to GPs for undetected cases; outcomes/processes assessed.
Randomized trial using ESRA-C to provide clinicians with patient-reported symptom/QoL summaries vs control; increased discussion of issues.

RCT in clinical practice where a RA flare PROM (FLARE-RA) was administered and acted upon (nurse counseling/expedited visit) vs usual care; compares PROM-guided feedback/intervention to no routine PROM, assessing disease activity/processes.
Narrative/overview piece describing PROM use; not a randomized trial and no direct PROM feedback comparison.
Review/guidance on implementing PROs; not an RCT testing PROM feedback vs no feedback.
RCT of a therapeutic life-review intervention; no PROM feedback to clinicians/patients as the intervention.
Patient- and evaluator-masked RCT: screening via a patient-reported depression screener with result communicated/offered treatment vs delayed/no feedback; assesses depressive symptoms and QoL.
Practice-level RCT of collaborative depression care management; not a direct test of PROM feedback vs no feedback.
RCT where AEP (patient-reported adverse effects PROM) scores were provided to physicians vs not; outcomes include AEP and QOLIE-31.
RCT comparing continuous patient-reported outcome feedback (PCOMS) to no feedback in psychotherapy; assesses patient outcomes and processes.
Intervention uses device-based monitoring/feedback of physical activity, not PROMs feedback; not within PROMs-specific scope.
Randomized feedback in undergraduate volunteers (non-clinical setting); not clinical practice PROMs feedback trial.
Cluster RCT in primary care using patient-reported previsit questionnaire (including YV items) with results delivered to clinicians vs without; outcome is process of care (discussion frequency).
RCT where QoL PROM assessments were routinely collected and fed back to patients and HCPs vs usual care; effects on communication/processes and patient-reported outcomes.
RCT in primary care disclosing composite patient-reported screening results to GPs vs blinded; assesses recognition, conversations, and follow-up (processes).
Methodological classification paper; not a randomized trial or PROM feedback comparison.
Cluster RCT providing physicians with patients’ patient-reported alcohol screening results and individualized recommendations vs control; measures discussions and drinking outcomes.
Systematic review; not a primary randomized trial.
Insufficient evidence of PROMs feedback; appears to be behavior feedback to patients rather than PROMs to clinicians/patients in clinical decision-making.
Pilot cluster RCT of a team communication platform; not a direct PROMs feedback intervention (general messaging/symptom reporting rather than structured PROM feedback).
Cluster RCT providing surgeons with peer-benchmarked PROMs feedback and education vs no feedback; patient-reported outcomes assessed.
RCT delivering patient-reported progress feedback to therapists versus control; evaluates outcomes and session use.
RCT in primary care providing GPs with results of a self-administered computerized patient-reported assessment vs GHQ vs no info; assesses clinical outcomes and processes.
Randomized allocation of pediatricians to HRQoL PROM monitoring with face-to-face discussion vs usual care; improved HRQoL; fits PROM feedback in practice.

Cluster RCT implementing the STarT Back Tool (patient-reported risk stratification) integrated into EHR to guide care vs control; uses PROM-derived info to inform treatment; assesses outcomes/processes.
RCT of a recovery-focused assessment/counseling package; not PROM feedback intervention.
Guidance/editorial; not a randomized trial.

RCT among inpatients comparing personalized computer-generated feedback letters based on self-reported screening (patient-reported data) and counseling vs assessment only; patient-reported alcohol outcomes.
Protocol for a non-inferiority study on PROM administration modes; not results of a PROM feedback RCT.
Randomized, controlled study providing SF-36 PROM results to physicians vs withholding; evaluates process of care and patient satisfaction.
RCT providing teens with personalized feedback and clinicians with decision support based on patient-reported screening vs usual care; assesses counseling (process) and risk behaviors (outcomes).
Realist synthesis review; not an RCT.
Randomized study where patients completed symptom/preference reports and this was provided to patients/clinicians vs control; assesses congruence (process).
RCT where patient-reported AEP scores were provided to clinicians vs usual care; assesses AEP and QOLIE-89.

Although randomized, the intervention centers on telehealth self-monitoring and nurse feedback likely based on clinical/physiologic data; the abstract does not indicate PROMs feedback to clinicians/patients as the intervention.
Randomized comparison of usual care versus provision of patient progress feedback to therapists and to both patients and therapists in psychotherapy; directly tests PROMs feedback effects.
Instrument development/psychometric testing; not a randomized trial of PROMs feedback in clinical practice.
Cluster-randomized trial where patient-reported symptoms are fed back to oncologists via printed longitudinal summaries versus no printout; matches PROMs feedback criteria.
Group-randomized design; clinicians receive tailored reports based on patient web symptom assessments; evaluates PROMs feedback to providers versus usual care.
Prospective randomized initiative providing real-time patient experience feedback to providers to improve care; aligns with PROMs feedback to clinicians.
Design not clearly randomized and focuses on prescreening and documentation rather than a randomized PROMs feedback comparison.
This is a review article rather than a primary randomized trial of PROMs feedback.

Comparative clinics including a feedback arm providing detailed patient mental health and preference information to clinicians; consistent with PROMs feedback in practice; randomization not explicit but likely by clinic; included conservatively.
Randomized trial of symptom monitoring plus feedback versus usual care in survivors; tests PROMs feedback on HRQoL and communication.
Randomized controlled trial providing physicians with patients’ self-reported functional status and management suggestions versus control; direct PROMs feedback.
Randomized comparison of feedback to therapist and/or patient versus no feedback in psychotherapy; evaluates PROMs feedback effects.
Randomized trial implementing routine standardized outcome assessments with periodic feedback versus usual care; tests PROMs feedback impact.
Randomized trial adding personalized feedback on patient status to guided self-care versus no added feedback; direct PROMs feedback to patients.
Although randomized symptom reporting, the abstract does not indicate that reported symptoms were fed back to clinicians or patients; focus is on reporting alone rather than feedback.
Randomized trial where patients report symptoms and clinicians receive printouts and nurses receive alerts; direct PROMs feedback versus usual care.
Randomized comparison of outcome monitoring feedback to therapists versus no feedback; examines moderators; fits PROMs feedback criteria.
Compares a decision aid to standard education; not a PROMs feedback intervention to clinicians/patients in routine care.
ED intervention based on a screening tool with nursing assessment and referrals; not PROMs feedback aimed at influencing ongoing clinical care decisions via PROMs.

Pilot RCT of additional patient self-reporting; abstract does not clearly indicate structured PROMs feedback to clinicians beyond standard monitoring; primary focus is AE detection rather than PROMs feedback.
Randomized trial where clinicians received graphical symptom reports with alerts during rounds; direct PROMs feedback to care teams.

Randomized comparison of remote symptom and biomarker monitoring via apps versus standard face-to-face care; clinicians use patient-reported symptom data to manage care; aligns with PROMs feedback in practice.
Randomized trial giving patients access to a self-assessment/self-monitoring platform intended to enhance patient–physician interactions; constitutes feedback to patients about their own PROMs.
SMS-based brief intervention for alcohol use outside routine clinical care; not a PROMs feedback intervention to clinicians/patients within clinical practice.
Cluster-randomized inpatient study with weekly standardized assessments and continuous feedback to patients and clinicians; directly tests PROMs feedback.
Randomized clinical trial where physicians received patient depression scores and patient-specific recommendations prior to assessment; PROMs feedback to clinicians.
Both arms had access to the app; comparison is reminders versus no reminders, not PROMs feedback versus no feedback.
Pilot intervention with IVR monitoring and clinician alerts; randomization is not stated/unclear; selection requires randomized trials.
Questionnaire development/validation study; not a randomized trial of PROMs feedback.
Cluster-randomized trial comparing generic and patient-specific feedback of family-reported end-of-life outcomes versus no feedback; matches PROMs feedback intervention.
Programmatic/organizational report; not a randomized trial of PROMs feedback.
Service delivery comparison (nurse-led telephone vs hospital follow-up); no PROMs feedback intervention component.
Randomized trial provided physician-targeted treatment recommendations following screening, but did not compare provision of PROM scores/feedback to clinicians or patients versus no PROM feedback.
Randomized trial where both arms completed symptom PROMs but only intervention clinicians received the PROM summary (feedback). Assessed symptom distress and care processes.
Three-arm randomized trial: ESM self-monitoring with weekly feedback vs without feedback vs TAU in depression. Tests PROM-based feedback to patients on patient-reported outcomes (empowerment).
Randomized rehab trial comparing Nintendo Wii vs conventional therapy; not a PROMs feedback intervention (PROMs only as outcomes).
Randomized clinical trial of continuous progress feedback (PROMs on treatment progress/alliance) provided to clients and therapists vs TAU; patient outcomes assessed.
Instrument development/validation/utility report (COOP charts), not a randomized trial of PROM feedback vs no feedback.
Randomized controlled trial providing PROMIS Pain Interference CAT-based feedback to patients before clinic visit vs no feedback; evaluated patient-physician communication and satisfaction.
Study examined providing client progress feedback and clinical support tools in psychotherapy vs usual care, aiming to improve outcomes; consistent with PROMs feedback paradigm.
Systematic review; not a primary randomized trial comparing PROM feedback vs no feedback.
Cluster randomized trial feeding back questionnaire data on asthma control and utilization to primary care teams vs no feedback; outcomes included symptoms, service use, and medication.
Editorial/commentary on using PROMs for NHS performance; not a randomized trial.
Randomized trial of PRIME-MD (patient-reported diagnostic instrument) with report to physician vs no report; assessed impact on diagnosis/referral (process of care).
Randomized design where some physicians reviewed patients’ SIP (PROM) prior to visit vs not; evaluated recognition of disabilities and communication (process of care).
Randomized comparison of clinicians using COOP health status charts during encounter vs no PROM assessment; assessed process of care and satisfaction.

Randomized mHealth trial added automated feedback to informal caregivers while both arms received clinician alerts; not a comparison of PROM feedback to clinicians/patients versus no PROM feedback, and feedback target was caregiver.
Randomized trial of stellate ganglion block for PTSD; not related to PROMs feedback.

Feasibility randomized trial of PROMs (PHQ, Distress Thermometer, PSYCHLOPS) monitoring in primary care depression vs usual care; feedback of scores to patients left to practitioners, but aligns with PROMs feedback evaluation.
Randomized study in managed behavioral healthcare: clinicians received SCL-90 PROM feedback vs no report; showed improved mental health outcomes.
Cluster RCT (DIALOG): structured patient–clinician dialogue with immediate feedback displays of patients’ ratings vs usual care; assessed quality of life, needs, and satisfaction.
Non-trial narrative/methods piece (PROMIS initiative) with mismatched abstract content; not a randomized PROM feedback comparison.
Randomized clinical trial feeding back GHQ screening results to primary care clinicians to improve detection/management of mental morbidity, focusing on older adults.
Randomized trial providing ongoing patient/therapist feedback on treatment progress plus decision-support tools vs treatment-as-usual; improved outcomes for at-risk patients.
Randomized controlled study using a depression self-rating scale during GP consultations vs TAU, with results used to inform discussions; assessed depression, QoL, and medication adherence.
Systematic review of PROM feedback interventions; not a primary randomized trial.
Randomized controlled trial providing feedback of detailed physical functioning assessment to patients and their physicians vs assessment alone; evaluated function and SF-36 outcomes.
Narrative/implementation review; not a randomized trial of PROMs feedback.
Qualitative study; not a randomized trial of PROM feedback.
Study protocol for web-based CBT; not a completed randomized trial of PROMs feedback in clinical practice versus no feedback.
Bibliographic study of PROM measures; not a randomized trial of PROM feedback.
Randomized trial where both groups produced reports for dentists (no true no-feedback comparator); not a PROM feedback vs no feedback comparison.
Randomized controlled trial monitoring and discussing psychological well-being in diabetes outpatients vs standard care; assessed mood (PROMs), HbA1c, and care evaluation.
Narrative/overview on moving PROs into practice; not a randomized trial.

Online MTurk randomized message experiment to optimize tailored feedback for behavioral intentions; not a clinical practice trial and does not compare PROM feedback to clinicians/patients versus no feedback.
Qualitative interview study of health visitors’ practices; not a randomized trial of PROM feedback.

Randomized trial in primary care; providers in intervention received completed PHQ-9 (a PROM) at baseline vs not. Assesses effects on outcomes and management; matches PROM feedback vs no feedback in clinical practice.
Validation/screening performance study of a hearing self-assessment questionnaire; no randomized comparison of PROM feedback to clinicians/patients versus no feedback.
Laboratory self-tracking study of physiology feedback; not clinical practice and not PROM feedback to healthcare providers/patients for care decisions.

Cluster RCT implementing structured readiness assessments including patient self-assessment (a PROM) used by nurses to inform discharge. Compares protocols vs usual care on readmissions; within scope of PROM feedback in clinical practice.

Both arms provided clinician summaries; randomization tested added self-care/communication coaching/tracking, not PROM feedback vs no feedback. Does not directly test impact of PROM feedback per protocol.
Randomized alerting of residents to self-administered depression questionnaire scores (PROM) versus no alert; tests impact on recognition/management in clinical practice.
Randomized provision of patient progress feedback (OQ-45 PROM) and support tools to therapists versus usual care; assesses outcomes in routine inpatient psychosomatic care.
Narrative literature review; not a randomized primary trial.
Participatory surveillance cohort evaluating reporting performance; not a randomized PROM feedback trial in clinical care.
Randomized controlled trial providing HRQoL assessment feedback to clinicians vs no feedback in routine outpatient care; evaluates effects on communication/management and outcomes.

RCT of a web-based self-management system where patients self-monitor symptoms and adherence; data are monitored with real-time feedback/support from a nurse case manager (provider feedback). Compares against usual care; aligns with PROM/ePRO feedback to clinicians/patients in clinical practice.
Randomized conditions varying PROM distress screening/feedback and triage vs minimal screening; examines impact on distress and referrals; aligns with PROM feedback in clinical practice.
Debate/editorial on systematic reviews of complex interventions; not a randomized trial.
RCT of clinician communication skills training; not PROM feedback to clinicians/patients.
Cluster RCT where physicians were notified of GDS (PROM) scores vs usual care; assesses diagnosis, treatment, outcomes; matches PROM feedback vs no feedback.
Randomized feedback of BDI (PROM) scores to GPs vs no feedback; examines diagnosis/management and outcomes; consistent with protocol.

Cluster RCT delivering patient-specific pre-visit reports (from patient-reported data) to both patients and clinicians to prime discussions, compared with usual care; tests process-of-care outcomes in clinical practice; within scope.
Commentary/opinion; not a randomized trial.

Study design describes electronic randomization into arms with feedback to patient and/or rheumatologist versus neither. Although reporting early recruitment, the intervention directly manipulates PROM feedback; include at title/abstract screening conservatively.

Cluster RCT of tailored risk information to patients/physicians to increase CRC screening discussions; focuses on risk factors/education rather than PROMs of health outcomes; outside PROM feedback scope.
Nurse-managed telephone follow-up intervention; not PROM feedback to clinicians/patients versus no feedback.
Systematic review of RCTs; not a primary randomized trial for inclusion.
Methodology/guideline paper; not a randomized trial.
Conceptual/methodological article; not a randomized trial.

RCT comparing standard care to an ePRO system with online questionnaires and remote NP review/triage—i.e., clinician feedback on patient-reported symptoms; aligns with PROM feedback in clinical practice.
FOCUS RCT investigated routine completion and feedback of outcome measures vs control in adult mental health; examines patient outcomes; within PROM feedback scope.
RCT with computerized HRQoL measurement and immediate feedback to physicians vs usual consultations; evaluates outcomes and changes in management; matches PROM feedback criterion.
Overview/review of phase III trials; not a primary randomized trial testing PROM feedback.
Implementation trial of guideline adherence using outreach/education/website; not a PROM feedback vs no feedback intervention.
Software product description; not a clinical trial.
